description: This Java interface defines a builder pattern for constructing instances of MappingContext with methods to set various properties such as mapping engine, options, and message mapping conditions.

classes.name: MappingContextBuilder
classes.description: A builder interface for creating MappingContext instances with fluent methods for setting properties.

methods.name: mappingEngine
methods.description: Sets the MappingEngine identifier for the builder.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the mapper using a JsonObject.

methods.name: incomingConditions
methods.description: Sets conditions for mapping incoming messages, given as a map of string keys and values.

methods.name: outgoingConditions
methods.description: Sets conditions for mapping outgoing messages, given as a map of string keys and values.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a new instance of MappingContext based on the configured properties.
